description: Get items linked to a tag. By default returns every type in full — on large tags that can be a huge response, so prefer types/status/summary to narrow it (e.g. types=['tasks'], status='pending', summary=true to review a project's open tasks). When tasks are included, the response also contains `sections`: the tag page's task sections with their task_ids (header_id null = tasks outside any section).

summary.description: Return lightweight items (ids, titles, excerpts) instead of full rows — recommended unless full content is needed

types.description: Only fetch these item types (default: all)

name: get_tag_items
